read_gap.handling: Archive No-Read Fence preserved. Targeted lookup did not identify unambiguous Home-latest/Active-8 paths; no broad archive read or stale-derived inference was used. Fresh MISSION_STATE and exact-current executable/contracts control this review.

material_delta.finding: Two routing facts that materially change gear selection remain caller-authored. First, current_gear is accepted as any G1..G6 string and drives both v2 one-step upshift hysteresis and v2.1 anti-thrash; a caller that reports G5 while canonical runtime is G1 can permit an inherited G6 path that canonical one-step hysteresis should have capped near G2. Second, verification_stage can be caller-set to C_VERIFIED, bypassing the UNVERIFIED/CANDIDATE G4 cap without a trusted C-verifier receipt. These are control-state authority gaps independent of the already-open Experience-credit receipt gaps.
material_delta.required_change: Live/adoptable Gearbox must derive current_gear from canonical runtime/shift state and derive verification_stage from trusted formal/evidence receipts. Caller values may be diagnostic assertions only and must be compared against canonical state; mismatch fails closed. Bind current_gear to runtime/installation identity plus monotonic shift-state record/policy hash, and bind C_VERIFIED to exact evidence hash, verifier identity, mission/step/scope, freshness/revocation and acceptance record.

agreements: DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND are classified as operational-only, not verified Experience.
HEARTBEAT/POLL/RETRY/WAIT/SCHEDULER_WAKE remain zero Experience; window age and runtime uptime are not Experience.
Safety/recovery downshifts are not blocked by the v2.1 anti-thrash branch because it suppresses only selected_n > current_n.
formal_mutation_allowed remains false and P_base remains read-only.
GEARBOX_V2_1_CONTRACT correctly keeps speedup status NOT_YET_STATISTICALLY_ESTABLISHED.
Verified Gearbox v1 and Step009 Heartbeat verified foundation remain preserved by this candidate-only review.

disagreements.finding: secretary_signal_fresh and authority_conflict are caller-supplied rather than derived from trusted timestamp/TTL/source/authority/replay evidence.
disagreements.required_change: Use replay-resistant secretary and authority envelopes; fresh authority comparison is computed by trusted runtime, not caller booleans.

disagreements.finding: freshness/conflict controls have no strict runtime bool validation; truthy non-bools can alter behavior.
disagreements.required_change: Reject non-bool values fail-closed, then replace free booleans with evidence-bound derived controls.

disagreements.finding: current_gear is caller-supplied and controls v2 hysteresis plus v2.1 anti-thrash. Forging a higher current gear can weaken the intended one-step upshift bound; forging a lower gear can create unnecessary holds/downstream latency.
disagreements.required_change: Read current gear from canonical monotonic shift/runtime state bound to installation/runtime identity and policy hash; caller mismatch is fail-closed diagnostic evidence only.

disagreements.finding: verification_stage=C_VERIFIED is accepted as a free caller string. It can remove the v2 G4 cap without proving independent C verification of the exact current artifact/scope.
disagreements.required_change: Derive verification stage from exact verifier/acceptance receipts bound to evidence hash, mission/step/scope, verifier identity, freshness/revocation and installation/workspace identity.

disagreements.finding: verified Experience is controlled by event kind plus a free verification flag without exact evidence hash and trusted C/independent verifier receipt.
disagreements.required_change: Require canonical evidence/event fingerprint plus trusted verifier receipt and durable acceptance binding.

disagreements.finding: bool(...) converts nonempty values such as 'false' into True in verification paths.
disagreements.required_change: Reject non-bool verification values fail-closed; strict bool does not replace verifier authority.

disagreements.finding: dedupe trusts caller event_id, so identical evidence can be replayed under new IDs.
disagreements.required_change: Canonical evidence lineage plus verifier/acceptance identity controls uniqueness.

disagreements.finding: aggregate_experience_events recreates seen=set() each call; identical events can be re-credited across polling, restart or rollback.
disagreements.required_change: Durable replay-resistant accepted-event registry with monotonic rollback protection.

disagreements.finding: event_id is not immutably bound to event kind, evidence and verifier receipt across runs.
disagreements.required_change: Seal EventIdentity on first acceptance; same-ID/different-binding is IDENTITY_CONFLICT; exact replay is no-op.

disagreements.finding: select_gear_v2_1 recomputes verified credit directly from caller event fields instead of consuming ledger-authorized acceptance.
disagreements.required_change: Single authoritative accepted-event receipt path; receipt-less decision emits zero verified credit.

disagreements.finding: select_gear_v2_1 likewise recomputes operational progress from caller event_kind, allowing decision-call frequency to fabricate throughput.
disagreements.required_change: Operational progress must use the same durable monotonic accepted-event receipt path; decision calls never create progress.

disagreements.finding: recent_shift_rate_ratio is caller-supplied and can activate or bypass anti-thrash.
disagreements.required_change: Derive from canonical append-only shift ledger with numerator, denominator, window, sample count, runtime identity and policy hash.

disagreements.finding: ratio>=0.50 has no sample-size/window/confidence semantics; 1/1 can trigger a hold.
disagreements.required_change: Precommit minimum support, window and release semantics; thresholds remain TEST_REQUIRED.

disagreements.finding: anti-thrash can indefinitely suppress a safe upshift and hide cycle/closure/recovery performance regression.
disagreements.required_change: Bound hold/release/cooldown and require paired non-regression tests.

disagreements.finding: verified_progress_density is caller-supplied and currently reason-only; future behavioral use could become self-reinforcing.
disagreements.required_change: Keep observational until independently derived over precommitted denominator/window and causal anti-self-reinforcement tests pass.

disagreements.finding: 5/4/3 and operational 1 are engineering heuristics, not calibrated capability/truth/trust/personality measurements.
disagreements.required_change: Forbid aggregate score as capability truth, Trust, Identity/Personality evidence or promotion threshold; weights remain TEST_REQUIRED.

Compare matched workloads on durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with equal-or-better verification/risk; commit count and awake time are excluded.

statistical_risks: Caller-forged current_gear changes hysteresis exposure and can bias apparent shift-rate, latency and throughput comparisons.
Caller-forged C_VERIFIED changes reachable gear distribution, confounding any v2.1 speed comparison with verification-stage misclassification.
Repeated decision calls can inflate operational_progress_delta without new durable acceptance and directly bias durable_progress_per_wake.
Caller-controlled shift-rate provenance permits anti-thrash activation or bypass bias.
Small-n shift ratios can create false-positive anti-thrash.
Anti-thrash can lower gear_shift_rate while worsening cycle/recovery latency or verified closure throughput.
verified_progress_density lacks denominator/window/independence and can become self-reinforcing.
Transient event-id dedupe permits longitudinal inflation across polling/restarts and semantic rebinding.
5/4/3 credits are ordinal engineering heuristics, not interval-scale capability measurements.
Unmatched speed comparisons are confounded by workload mix, incidents, verifier availability, routing state and runtime conditions.
proposed_tests: GB21-FRESHNESS-FORGE-001 stale RED/ORANGE with caller-forged freshness cannot influence gear without trusted freshness evidence.
GB21-AUTHORITY-CONFLICT-002 a newer canonical authority snapshot wins even when caller supplies authority_conflict=false.
GB21-CURRENT-GEAR-FORGE-026 canonical runtime gear=G1 while caller reports G5: inherited/upshift logic must use G1, and caller G5 cannot bypass one-step hysteresis or alter anti-thrash state.
GB21-VERIFICATION-STAGE-FORGE-027 caller reports C_VERIFIED without exact trusted C receipt: treat as unverified/fail-closed and retain the G4 cap; stale/revoked/cross-scope receipts are rejected.
GB21-SHIFT-SMALL-N-004 1/1 and 2/3 cannot activate production anti-thrash absent precommitted support semantics.
GB21-ANTI-THRASH-RECOVERY-005 after a burst, stable safe demand regains upshift within bounded policy with non-regressed cycle/closure/recovery metrics.
GB21-PROGRESS-DENSITY-FORGE-007 density=1.0 alone confers no routing/Experience/promotion/authority effect.
GB21-EVENT-ID-REWRITE-008 same canonical evidence under 10,000 distinct IDs credits once.
GB21-VERIFIER-BOOL-COERCION-009 and GB21-SECRETARY-BOOL-COERCION-010 reject non-bool control values.
GB21-VERIFIER-EVIDENCE-011 verified kind without exact evidence hash plus trusted verifier receipt gets zero verified credit.
GB21-OPERATIONAL-ONLY-013 DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND never change verified Experience, P_base, Identity, Personality, Governance or formal authority.
GB21-CREDIT-SCORE-014 equal aggregate scores from different event mixes cannot imply equivalent capability or trigger promotion.

GB21-PAIRED-SPEED-015 paired matched baseline reports durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio, recovery_latency and verification/risk non-regression; commit/wake/awake time excluded.
GB21-SHIFT-RATE-PROVENANCE-017 canonical shift-ledger derivation wins over caller ratio.
GB21-CROSS-RUN-SAME-ID-018 / ROLLBACK-LEDGER-019 / POLL-REPLAY-020 prove exactly-once acceptance across calls, restart, rollback and polling.
GB21-EVENT-REBIND-021 same event_id with changed kind/evidence/verifier receipt is IDENTITY_CONFLICT; exact original replay is no-op.
GB21-DIRECT-CREDIT-BYPASS-022 and DUAL-PATH-CONSISTENCY-023 require decision projection to bind the same acceptance_record_hash as the canonical ledger.
GB21-OPERATIONAL-CREDIT-BYPASS-024 10,000 receipt-less DURABLE_PROGRESS decision calls create zero additional operational progress.
GB21-SPEED-METRIC-LEDGER-BINDING-025 durable_progress_per_wake numerator comes only from accepted durable-progress records; caller event repetitions, polls and window uptime cannot change it.
release_condition: No C PASS claim and no formal/code mutation.
Fresh secretary influence derives from trusted replay-resistant freshness evidence and exact fresh-authority comparison; non-bool freshness/conflict fails closed.
current_gear is derived from canonical monotonic runtime/shift state; caller state cannot weaken hysteresis or anti-thrash.
C_VERIFIED and other verification stages are derived from exact trusted verifier/acceptance evidence with scope/freshness/revocation binding; caller stage labels have no routing authority.
Verified Experience and operational progress share exactly one authoritative durable acceptance path; select_gear_v2_1 cannot create either credit from caller event fields.
Accepted-event uniqueness resists same-evidence/new-ID laundering, same-ID/different-binding rebinding, repeated calls, polling, restart and rollback.
recent_shift_rate is internally derived from canonical shift ledger with precommitted window/sample semantics; anti-thrash cannot hide material cycle/closure/recovery regression.
verified_progress_density remains observational until independently derived and causal/non-self-reinforcing tests pass.
DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND remain operational-only; heartbeat/poll/retry/window age/runtime maintenance remain zero Experience; P_base stays read-only.
Credit weights remain heuristic TEST_REQUIRED and cannot become promotion/capability/Trust/Identity/Personality truth.

Any speedup claim uses durable acceptance-ledger numerators and requires paired matched baseline on durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with verification/risk non-regression.
Verified Gearbox v1 and Step009 Heartbeat foundations remain preserved; v2.1 affected scope remains candidate until normal A->B->C adoption.
